deleteId].actual: Delete stream route by id; canonical id deleteStreamRoute.

getResourceSchema.issue: The {resource} path parameter reuses ResourceKindInPath, whose values are plural (routes, ssls, ...).
getResourceSchema.actual: GET /schema/{resource} expects the singular core.schema key (route, ssl, plugin_config, ...); plural names return 400 "not found schema". The validate endpoint does accept the plural names.
getResourceSchema.evidence: apisix/admin/schema.lua _M.get looks up core.schema[name]; live APISIX 3.19.0: GET /schema/routes -> 400 {"error_msg":"not found schema: routes"}, GET /schema/route -> 200 (2026-10-09).

notes.detail: Consumers are created/replaced with PUT on the collection; the identity is the `username` property in the body, not a path segment.
The request body is any JSON value (scalar, array or object) that replaces the value at the slash-separated sub_path.
Responds with the plain-text body `done` while declaring Content-Type: application/json (live APISIX 3.19.0); the client returns the raw string.
Secrets and plugin_metadata endpoints declare 200 responses as untyped objects (or inline schemas); DTOs for them are derived from the request schemas and examples.
HEAD /apisix/admin (operationId ping) is unauthenticated and returns 200 with no body.
SSLRead (responses) declares exactly the properties of SSL (requests) without write constraints, and APISIX strips key/keys on reads; a single Ssl DTO mirroring SSL serves both directions.
`label` matches resources that have the given label key (apisix/admin/v3_adapter.lua compares keys only); `key:value` never matches.
